title: The Flaming Youth Revue act
summary: Dance recalls his comic exit routines; Norvo describes the act's three boys and a girl and opening number.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: Well, listen when you talk about the dance routine, the reason I stopped you was, you used to send me into hysterics, you used to send Mildred and I into hysterics by showing us how you used to get off stage -- do you remember you used to go dance backwards, the way you would leave the stage, and then somebody would pull you behind the curtain?

Yeah. Well those are the things I did in that act -- that Flaming Youth Review was a great act. We had three boys and this little girl. It was a great act. We opened it -- opened it singing, walking across the street -- I can't sing at all, but I just talk, you know --
In vaudeville you do these sorts of things.
